templates.why_chosen: High-confidence matrix exemplar at floor size, 8 components and 6 flows, with the row-equals-layer, column-equals-core-replica grid drawn literally: three identical Core columns each stack Driver, Application and Monitoring bands feeding one shared Aggregator.
templates.what_to_learn: Draw each replica as one column and each shared concern as one row so both axes carry meaning, keep every column's internal band colours identical, and route many-to-one aggregation as curved arrows into a single box at the margin instead of drawing every core's own output stage.

templates.why_chosen: A cautionary case: three concrete Core columns are drawn with no ellipsis at all, violating the template's own 'never three or more concrete copies' rule, even though the stacked Driver/Application/Monitoring bands are cleanly repeated.
templates.what_to_learn: Do not draw three or more full concrete replicas side by side as this figure does; collapse to two columns plus an ellipsis (or a Core N column) instead, while keeping its good idea of repeating the same colored Driver/Application/Monitoring bands identically in every column and fanning them back to one Aggregator.
